_comment: Sources crawled daily by scripts/crawl.py. type=repo crawls one repository; type=user crawls every public, non-fork repository of a user. default_language is used when nothing in the names says otherwise. exclude_paths (optional, per source) is a regex of committed paths to skip; by default vendor/, fixtures/, tests/ and similar folders are skipped. platforms lists the platforms kept (null = unknown); patches for other systems are listed under 'excluded' in index.json but not stored.
